narrative: As a first‑time Founder & CEO in Egypt with an industrial engineering background, prioritize fast market validation, disciplined startup finance, and a repeatable go-to-market engine. Prove problem–solution fit with lean experiments tailored to local payment, logistics, and regulatory realities, then manage burn and FX to extend runway while preparing investor-ready models and metrics. Build a simple B2B sales playbook aligned with Egyptian procurement. When early traction and KPIs are in place, consider accelerator readiness (e.g., Flat6Labs) to sharpen fundraising and growth discipline.
